state.waitingNoTime: Queued at SEFAZ — waiting for the next window
state.stalled: The search is taking longer than usual. Try again.

reason.not_interested: SEFAZ does not release this invoice to the carrier (it is not listed on the invoice). Send the XML.
reason.summary_only: SEFAZ only released the summary of this invoice. Send the XML.
reason.not_found: SEFAZ could not find this invoice. Check the key or send the XML.
reason.expired: SEFAZ no longer keeps this invoice's XML (period expired). Send the XML.
reason.cancelled: This invoice was cancelled by the issuer. It cannot be imported.
reason.denied: This invoice was denied by SEFAZ. It cannot be imported.
reason.certificate_mismatch: The company certificate does not match the one used for the lookup. Send the XML or check the certificate.
reason.invalid_key: This invoice key is invalid. Check the reading or send the XML.
reason.sefaz_unavailable: SEFAZ is unavailable right now. Try again shortly or send the XML.

error.generic: Could not look up this invoice. Try again.
error.INVALID_ACCESS_KEY: The key read is invalid. Check the reading.
error.NFE_DISTRIBUTION_NOT_CONFIGURED: The SEFAZ lookup is not configured for this company. Send the XML.
error.NFE_ACCESS_KEY_LOOKUP_CONFLICT: A lookup for this key is already running. Try again shortly.
error.NFE_ACCESS_KEY_LOOKUP_QUEUE_FULL: The SEFAZ lookup queue is full. Try again in a few minutes.
error.RATE_LIMITED: Too many lookups in a short time. Wait a moment and try again.
error.NFE_ACCESS_KEY_LOOKUP_REQUEST_FAILED: Connection failure while looking up the invoice. Try again.
error.NFE_ACCESS_KEY_LOOKUP_RESPONSE_INVALID: Unexpected response while looking up the invoice. Try again.
